label: Quotient marketing event page, Metrics tab
description: The Quotient MARKETING EVENT page on its Metrics tab, rebuilt by hand from the captured product screen (Inter; the product's borders, radii, lucide icons and Tailwind colors). Header: the event title, a kebab button, the campaign chip (megaphone, campaign name, 'n/m' progress + a green ring that fills) and 'Threads (n) ↗'; Start Time (clock) and Owner (person) rows; the tab strip Brief / Details / Participants / Metrics with the active tab boxed. Then four KPI tiles with colored icons (Total Participants, Registered, Attended, No Shows, each with a caption), the Attendance Rate card (big green % + caption + rows Attended / No Shows / Total Registered) and the Registration Rate card (big blue % + caption + rows Registered / Invited / Cancelled / Total Participants). Below the fold, reached with the `scroll` verb: the Participant Status Breakdown (one labeled bar per status, 'value (pct%)'). Every word, name and number is data; the defaults are a big, successful launch webinar ('Flows launch webinar', campaign 'Q3 Flows launch', owner Jordan Lee; 1,240 participants, 1,180 registered, 742 attended, 438 no-shows, 63% attendance, 95% registration -- all consistent across tiles, cards and bars). ENTRANCE (on the timeline, scrub-safe; data.at shifts it, entrance:'none' = settled from frame 0 for stills): header and tabs rise in, the campaign ring fills, the tiles land with a stagger and their numbers ROLL UP (thousands separators), the rate cards land and their big percentages roll up, the card rows cascade in with their numbers rolling, the breakdown bars grow from zero. SCRIPT verbs (data.script, [{action, at, ...}]): count {target, to, display?, format?, duration?, highlight?: true} rolls a number from its current value to a new one (target = a tile label, a card title or 'attendance'/'registration' for the big %, a row label; exact names prefer tiles, so scope a row with scope:'attendance'|'registration'|'breakdown' or 'attendance.Attended'; a breakdown row's bar moves with it) -- script several counts at the same `at` to keep the page consistent; highlight {target: tile label | card title | row label | tab | button ('campaign', 'threads') | anchor name, duration?, color?} draws an accent ring + wash over it; switch-tab {to: 'Participants'} moves the active tab; scroll {to: 'breakdown' | 'top' | 'bottom' | anchor | row/card text | em number, duration?} slides the page inside the card (cursor aims follow it); set-text {target: current words, to} swaps visible copy (title, owner, labels, chip); plus the shared cursor verbs move-cursor / click / hover / wait (target by visible words: 'Participants', 'Threads', 'Attended', 'Attendance Rate'; or named positions in cursor_targets). CAMERA ANCHORS: header, tabs, kpis, attendance, registration, breakdown (camera_moves [{type:'zoom', anchor:'<componentId>.kpis'}]). SIZING: laid out in em off the box (1em = 1/128.6 of the width, capped so the page down to the rate cards fits the height; ResizeObserver refit), so it reads the same at any size. Standard use inside the Quotient shell: quotient-app-shell at x 1.2%, y 2%, width 97.6%, height 96% with show_panel:false and nav_active:'calendar' (the Events rail icon), breadcrumbs e.g. ['Events', 'Flows launch webinar']; this component over the content well at x 4.7%, y 8%, width 93.7%, height 89% with docked:true. Standalone (docked omitted) it is a white rounded card with a visible border + shadow. Example data: {docked: true, title: 'Flows launch webinar', owner: 'Jordan Lee', script: [{action:'count', target:'Attended', to:812, at:3.2}, {action:'count', target:'No Shows', to:368, at:3.2}, {action:'count', target:'attendance.Attended', to:812, at:3.2}, {action:'count', target:'attendance.No Shows', to:368, at:3.2}, {action:'count', target:'Attendance Rate', to:69, at:3.2}, {action:'highlight', target:'Attendance Rate', at:3.2, duration:1.5}, {action:'scroll', to:'breakdown', at:6, duration:1}]}.

campaign.label: Campaign chip: {name (default 'Q3 Flows launch'), progress: 'n/m' text (default '4/4'; false hides it), pct?: ring fill 0-100 (default from progress)} -- or just a name string

threads.label: Threads button: a number (-> 'Threads (n)') or the full text (default 'Threads (4)')

start_time.label: Start Time value (default 'Thursday, September 10, 2026 at 12:00 PM EDT')

meta.label: Override the meta rows entirely: [{label, value, icon: clock|user|calendar|map-pin|video|info}]

tab_style.label: 'box' (default, the active tab outlined as captured) | 'line' (underline only)

kpis.label: KPI tiles: [{label, value: number (rolls up), caption, icon: users|user-check|trending-up|user-x|user-plus|calendar|mail|eye|star|..., color: blue|green|emerald|orange|red|violet|amber|<css>, format?: number|percent|currency|compact, decimals?, prefix?, suffix?, display?: final text override}] -- 4 fit best

attendance.label: Attendance Rate card: {title, icon, rate: number (rolls up as %), color (default emerald), caption, rows: [{label, value, total?: true (bold)}], display?}

registration.label: Registration Rate card: same shape (default blue 95%)

breakdown.label: Participant Status Breakdown (below the fold): {title, rows: [{label, value, color?, pct?}], total?: the 100% base (default the largest value)}; false removes the card

scroll.label: Where the page stands at open: 'top' (default) | 'breakdown' | 'bottom' | anchor | em number

entrance.label: 'none' = settled final state from frame 0 (stills); default = the full entrance performance

at.label: Shift the whole entrance by this many seconds (negative starts it under a relay join)

docked.label: true = flush in quotient-app-shell's content well (no outer border/shadow)

script.label: Performance: count {target, to, display?, format?, duration?, scope?, highlight?}, highlight {target, duration?, color?, scope?}, switch-tab {to}, scroll {to, duration?}, set-text {target, to}, move-cursor / click / hover / wait {target}

cursor_targets.label: Named cursor positions ({x, y} px or %) -- by default targets are found by their visible words
